visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A male main character with dark, styled hair and a white t-shirt faces the camera in a modern, brightly lit indoor studio. He holds an open Dior eyeshadow palette, showcasing five distinct shades ranging from pale nude to deep cocoa. He smiles broadly, displaying high energy and friendliness while the camera remains static at a medium close-up. (2) The scene transitions to a close-up of his forearm where five streaks of eyeshadow are swatched in a vertical line. He uses his index finger to point at the textures, highlighting the pigmentation against his skin. The lighting is flat and bright, ensuring the colors are accurately represented. (3) The sequence shifts to multiple close-ups of the man's eyes as he applies the makeup using various brushes. He demonstrates layering techniques, starting with a base orange and adding darker tones for depth. Small white subtitles appear at the bottom to explain his actions while his facial expressions remain focused and professional. (4) In the final phase, the man completes his makeup with pinkish blush and a nude lipstick. He holds both the eyeshadow palette and a matching blush compact towards the camera, smiling confidently. Graphic text overlays with positive attributes like 'elegant' and 'sweet' appear in the frame as he gives a final thumbs up.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-pitched, energetic male voice introduces the makeup palette with a fast speech rate and dynamic pitch variability. Simultaneously, an upbeat electronic pop BGM starts with a clear 4/4 beat. The environment is a clean studio with absolute minimal background noise. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs as the man closes the plastic eyeshadow case, marking a brief transition. The music continues its rhythmic drive while the speaker maintains high arousal and positive valence, inviting the audience to look closely at the product. (3) A distinct metallic snap is heard as he reopens the palette for a demonstration. The BGM remains dominant in the background mix. The male voice continues to describe the 'Ovaltine' color theme with professional clarity and friendly, animated intonation patterns. (4) Subtle friction and low-frequency rustling sounds are captured as the man applies the eyeshadow with a small brush. The music volume is slightly ducked to prioritize the instructional narration. Occasional 'ding' SFX emphasize the important text overlays appearing on the screen. (5) The finale features a swell in the background music's intensity as the speaker provides a conclusive summary. His voice becomes more authoritative and confident. A final hard cut in the audio track signals the end of the video presentation with a punchy finish.
